note: A CR byte can only enter a String via the \r escape inside an inline compound (Sec 3.7); canonical form never emits inline compounds for non-empty scalars, and no multi-line form can carry a raw CR either (Sec 3.2 treats bare CR as a line terminator). See Sec 5.9.7. The String is wrapped in an Object (key 's') so it is not the bare document root: a bare String would fail ScalarRoot first, and the fixture must exercise exactly its named reason code (Sec 5.9.0).
